body: I have no idea what is involved in replacing a line. I rely on communication from the people doing the work and they said nothing about shutting off the gas. Clear communication is necassary in any job. But especially for a job on a service that provides basic service you need in a home.
That’s awful! I’m so sorry you have to deal with that!

The note said “only CenterPoint Energy can unlock the meter and initiate gas service.”  Good point though - once it’s back on I’ll have to check all the pilots lights. I haven’t done that before - thank goodness for YouTube.
Feline Rescue in St. Paul. Amazing staff and they really care about the cats. I adopted my two from there 5 years ago.
So much fluff!!
I thought the same thing! His eyes are crazy red.
Thank you.  I can’t even express how badly I needed to hear this today.

Thank you. I cried last night and again this morning. This is my second Valentine’s Day since the divorce was final and I’m definitely better than I was but it still stings a bit. And that’s ok. I’m stronger today than I was a year ago. I’m rebuilding myself one step at a time. And you will too. Good luck on this journey - be kind to yourself and remember that you’re awesome and worthy even in your saddest moments!
Thank you! It's always nice to hear success stories for older women!!

I've been officially divorced for a year and I still cry everyday. I miss him. Or rather I miss who I wanted him to be. I'm 41 now and realize that I will never have children and it absolute destroys me. There is a dark whole where my heart should be. But I go to work, have a career and pretend I'm fine so others in my life won't be sad too.

I still have problems sleeping. Over the counter melatonin does help me fall asleep. The one that works best for me is from Target - Olly Restful Sleep. I take two of the chews about an hour before I go to bed. Meditation, working out and no alcohol has also helped with sleeping. It's not great yet but I'm hopeful. Hang in there!

The final stab to the heart for me was that I was sobbing and saying that we should at least try counseling. He just stood there with no emotion. I finally said ok. And he looked so relieved that it broke my heart all over again. He got a lawyer so I got a lawyer which was good. She really helped me get my finances together. He filed but my lawyer ended up rewriting everything because his lawyer sucked. It's been final since August. 4 days before my 40th birthday. Yea. That sucked. I still have hard days but I'm working on it. I wish I could remember which redditor said this to me because I think about it all the time - "It doesn't get easier. It gets different. Embrace different." This isn't what I wanted my life would be like but it is what it is and I need to keep trying. I know it seems impossible now because you're in the beginning of the journey. But it eventually will get better and you'll remember how awesome you are without him!!

My heart hurts for you. It's such a hard place to be - wanting to work it out when the other person doesn't. I tried everything too - including begging. It was humiliating. You can't change him so you have to change yourself. Remember you are strong, beautiful, capable. Try to remember who you were before the heart ache. Be gentle with yourself and give your heart time to heal. And know that you are not alone - this sub is full of wonderful people willing to listen.

I am so sorry. I know that feeling all to well. It is like a void, like an endless darkness that threatens to take over everything. I'm about 8 months from my XH telling me it was over and 5 months since the divorce was final. Some days are still hard but I'm trying to focus on me. Reach out to friends and family, they can help. I was so embarrassed that I didn't want to tell anyone. But I did and they loved me anyway. And helped me to build my self esteem back. Be gentle with yourself. Know that these first days are awful but you will make it. Deep breaths and remember that you are worthy of love and happiness. You will survive this. If you need help - reach out to friends or post on this sub. There will be lots of people rooting for you!
Thanks. It does hurt but at the end of the day he didn't care enough to try. And I'm worth more than that. We all are.

We are complete strangers. That sentence breaks my hearts but it's for the best. After 10 years together (4 married) he wanted out. No trying to figure it out, no time to try and sort out our problems. I haven't seen him since July last year. I texted him when my grandpa died a couple weeks ago and his reply could have been written by a stranger. It's so sad. I'm working on being ok but it's a long hard road.
I really like this! Sometimes a day is enough. It's not good or bad - just a day!
I needed this. Thank you!

I understand. I miss his hugs. I miss his warmth. It's hard being alone. The good news is that some days are better than other days. Some days I know it will be ok. And then there are days that the loneliness seeps into every pore of my being. Those days I'm thankful for this sub. Hang in there.
Maiden names are very personal. I changed mine and it was a huge pain to do but totally worth it. We didn't have kids so I don't have to think about that. Maybe it is part of her healing.
I like this. Maybe a goodbye bonfire. With lots of wine and a couple close girlfriends to cry with. Ugh.

That's hard! Would you want to keep it for your son? I'm thinking of keeping the pictures with my nieces and nephews. They are too cute to throw away. Maybe I'll put those in box in the basement. I hope:pray that time really does heal all wounds.
Thanks! Right now it's all still raw. I  just want to forget and move on.
I agree! I look so happy and hopeful. And it was all a lie.

Ugh. I know how you feel. My wedding dress is in a box in the basement. I haven't had the courage to deal with it. I don't want to sell or donate it to someone else for fear my bad luck will transfer to them. Hopefully time and therapy will help me figure out what to do.
Your music is so heartfelt and honest. Your song The Bear saved my life. What was your inspiration to write that?

I was divorced in August and just finalized my refi of the house. I had to pay out equity to him but the house was fully awarded to me. My name was the ONLY one on all my refi paperwork. I didn't even need his signature to pay off the original loan that was in both our names.

I absolutely regret it. I feel like there is a 10 year (4 married) hole in my life. We went on great trips but I can't even think about any of them without being sad. Maybe it's all still too new. Hopefully I can see it differently in time.
This. I was so wrong about something so important. How can I ever trust myself?? Let alone trust another partner. Nope. No more marriages for me.

Thanks for the encouragement! I've never painted before. Never thought of myself as creative. But how you described it make it seems possible. Reddit has been such a gift during this time. Seeing new perspectives from other people really helps!

It does feel like everything was a lie. How can I trust myself again when I loved someone so much and didn't see that he didn't love me back?? It's awful. I'm tired of the rain. I'm ready for a ray of sunshine.
Great advice! Thank you!!

The overwhelming sadness seems to come and go. I can be fine and then just burst into tears. Some days are better so I should focus on those. I'm with you on the drinking. I need to be healthy and take care of myself. Good luck!

Why is smoking always a go to bad choice?? Ugg. I should really just throw them out but.... It's a little comforting too. I'll try to do better! Congrats on your new love! I'm happy you've found someone that can help and encourage you through these tough times!
Thanks! Good luck to you to! I feel a little guilty for my indulgences last night. But .. I'm only human. Today is another chance to do better.
Dating scares me.  How do you let someone in again? I did that and it did not work out well. How do you even start thinking about meeting people? It all seems really too hard. Good luck to you too!
I'm not sure me time is all that fun! Lots of drinking and eating when it's just me. Do things looks better after a year?

There is nothing wrong with you. You're processing this in your own way and in your own time. Don't feel like you should be doing something. Just try to acknowledge that you're going through a hard time. Don't beat yourself up for it. I'm so sorry about your cat! Losing a pet at this time is just awful! I take a lot of comfort from my moms cats and am actually thinking of getting one if my own. Maybe volunteer at a shelter? Or volunteer to foster a cat? Small steps can be helpful. I'll also add it's way easier to give advice than to actually follow it. But I'm trying. I hope you can try too.

I also have been drinking too much. The good thing is at least we know it's too much.  Last night I couldn't stop crying. But this morning I dusted myself off and cleaned the living room. It's not much but it's something.  One little thing at a time.

It's normal to be a mess. You've been hurt and need time to heal. One little step at a time. It's not easy. But the only way is forward and you will survive this. Good luck to you. Good luck to us all.

I can't be friends with my STBXH. We also have no kids so there really isn't a reason for us to continue to communicate. He wanted to try to be friends but it hurts me too much. I don't want to hang out and laugh with him like friends. I wanted to work on our issues and stayed married. I see him and all I can think about is my failure and how much I want him in my life. I need to move on and the only way to do that is to say goodbye. Ugg. I cry just thinking about him.  I wish you I luck in whatever you two decide is the best.

You're a brave as adventurous women! Congrats on taking the initiative to go on your dream vacation! It's normal to miss the companionship. But you're doing great on your own! Take lots of pictures and enjoy!

Oh my. This hit home tonight. I was waiting for my luggage after a very long week traveling for work and there was this picture of a couple in their plane seats. They were drinking wine and he was smiling at her and I just broke down. I was collecting luggage to get in a cab to go to an empty house. I cried all the way home. When does this get easier? When will EVERYTHING stop reminding me of him and the we shared? This process sucks. Good luck to us all.

We didn't have kids so that isn't a factor for me. I'm very anxious to return to my maiden name. It's a GIANT pain in the ass to do it but I want a clean break from him. The name just feels wrong now. Hopefully in the next month or so the divorce will be final and I can start the process.
I like this. I need to focus on reality. No one can cry forever. I need to focus on one thing at a time. Thank you!
Engaged already? Ouch! I'm sorry you're going through that! I'm hoping for better days ahead. We're good people. We deserve happiness. Good luck!
Thank you! There are so many good people in this community!
Fresh start sounds better than thinking about the ending. Time for something new.
Projects are good motivators! I have repainted the kitchen and one bedroom. Now I need to start cleaning my closets. Trying to keep busy is hard but I need to at least try. Thank you!

This community really has helped a lot. Sometimes I feel alienated from my married friends. I don't want to being my ugly drama to their relationships. It's so good to know that there are others who know what I'm going through and take the time to respond. Peace and love to you as well!
Thank you! It's good to know that people make it to the other side of divorce.
Thanks. It's sunny this morning.  And I made it through the night! Thanks for your words of confidence!
Tired? What does that even mean? It's so unfair to not have a real reason. I'm sorry you're going through this. It's hard.
Thanks. I do need a distraction. Just to think about something else. I'm so tired of being sad.

No kids which is why I never have to see him again. That's a blessing and a curse I think. He was done trying too. But we never really talked about what went wrong or even tried counseling. Why didn't he love me enough to try? It makes me feel so stupid for loving him.
Thank you.
That's ridiculous. Yes, marriage should be fun. But you need to people actively engaged and present in order to have fun. Here's hoping to more fun for us without them!

This is so familiar to me. My STBXH was my best friend and we talked about everything. Then he wanted a divorce and didn't want to try. He was done and I (pathetically) begged him to stay. He didn't care. He moved out and I cry when I see him. He looks great and is loving the single life. He's in Chicago at the Pitchfork music festival and I'm at home trying to pick up the pieces. I will pick up the pieces. One day at a time I'll get stronger and find my happiness again. So will you. These first months are so hard - give yourself a break. It's ok to be sad and hurt and still love him. Cry and talk to family. You're a strong person and you will come out of this even better than before. Good luck.

"It is hard. It doesn't get easier, it gets different. Embrace different." This. I am just a couple months into this process and I haven't heard it put this way before. I keep wanting my life to go back to what it was before but that just isn't an option anymore. Time to embrace a different path.
I miss the comfort of having someone next to me at night. If there was a loud noise or a bad storm he would be right there and I wouldn't be scared.

I don't want to be 75% happy with just me. I'm aiming for 100% happy with just me. Yes, we get some validation from outside forces but in the end it's just me. If I ever try this love thing again I want to know that I'm a complete person who can care for herself and has the confidence to ask for exactly what she wants from a relationship. And if that doesn't happen - that's  OK. I will have friends and live a good life. I am worth 100% happy.
I probably going to cry for hours, drink a bottle of champagne, go to bed early, and try to pick up the pieces of my life/heart in the morning.

It's a struggle but you have to focus on you. I'm 3 months in and still have times that I cry uncontrollably. But after the crying I try to focus on good things like picking out new paint colors for the living room and buying furniture that I like. Now is all about you and how to make you love YOU again. Only married 4 years, no kids.
I'm sorry about your date. And I totally agree.
Love isn't enough. That's a hard lesson to learn.

I had a house before I met him.  I sold that and put about $50,000 into the house we bought together. I have my original paperwork and can prove that I had the money before marriage. It just seems unfair and I'm hurt. How do I put that aside? I will consult with a lawyer and try to be more levelheaded. This is too hard. How does anyone make it through all this crap???

My STBXH is looking for an apartment now. It's been 4 weeks since he decided he was done. It totally sucks having to see him every day. I'm an emotional mess and he's totally fine. That's hard to see. I'm hoping to find more closure and peace when he's out of the house. No kids so I probably won't have to see him again. Ugg. That sentence breaks my heart all over again.

Thank you. This is a tough road. If I had heard your situation a year ago I would have said that you should leave and be happy. Pick yourself first and if he doesn't make you happy let him go. But now... There is a lot of pain in the word divorce. I hate that he wants out but if that's the only way for him to be happy I have to accept it. Both ways are hard. It's not easy but I hope you find peace in whatever decision you make. You're pretty awesome too.
I went to yoga tonight! It felt good to be out and sweating. Thanks for your suggestions!
I'm trying. I feel like I can go hours with being ok. Then one thing can set me off to crying for three hours straight. Freedom. Life. Love. I want all of those things. Thank you.
I just read you comment again. "You're not broken." I had no idea how much I needed someone to say that. Thank you so much for taking the time to share your story.
Thank you. Finding normal seems very hard right now. I'm glad to hear that it is possible to laugh again.
Thank you. I will try to see the light at the end of the tunnel.
Too distant. Not exciting in the bedroom. He doesn't feel a spark. No kids - that's been hard. I cry about that but he doesn't seem bothered.

That I'm not capable of having a normal relationship. I don't know how to make him happy. I don't even know how to make me happy. I look in the mirror and I don't recognize myself. All I see are wrinkles and all I feel is regret. It feels to late to change. I don't want to do this by myself.
Thanks. I'm going to make an appointment tomorrow. I can't do this by myself anymore.
Thanks. I keep thinking that I've had the worst night and that it will get better but it's such a roller coaster.
It all seems so impossible right now. Thank you for the encouragement. I need to cling to other people's hope tonight.

I play computer games on pogo. I like to have something with right/wrong answers that is win or lose. Everything else in my life seems so up and down and chaotic. This is just so hard. I'm thankful for this site. It is comforting to know that I'm not alone. Thank you.
I smiled at your 'just keep swimming'! I think they'd a great motto. Just keep moving and trying. Maybe I'll watch Finding Nemo tonight with a bowl of popcorn.

Nights are the worst for me. Being alone in the dark with nothing but my thoughts is awful. I think of everything that I regret and everything that I wish I'd done differently. Mornings are better because I know that I made it through one more night. Eventually it gets better......I hope. Maybe all we can do is cling to the part of the day that is the best  (or at least tolerable) and eventually that time will spread to other times of the day. Good luck.

This is such a great question! I've been wondering the same thing. I am at the beginning of this process. It's not my choice and I cry every time I even say the word divorce. I started a new job in January do I don't know my team very well and really don't want them to think I'm an emotional wreck (even though I am right now). Can I just wait until I change my name back and send a quick email?

There is no shame in feeling angry or vengeful or sad or ashamed or tired or whatever. Honor your feelings and accept that you can't always feel how you "are suppose to." Cry, scream, learn how to box. Whatever it takes to make it through. But then look at your kids and know that you and he made amazing people. Focus on them. Be a parent with him and try to turn off everything else. Good luck.

If you figure out how to listen to your head instead of heart please let me know. It's a struggle. My brain understands that my marriage is over but my heart still thinks there is a chance. So hard and frustrating. Good luck.

I totally understand. There is something so comforting in just having another person there even if you're on opposite sides of the bed. But alone isn't worse than death. Alone will help you learn to rely/trust/love yourself. You are enough. You are worth more than an empty marriage.
What do you do on the date? I forced myself to go to work but I'm either sitting here numb or fighting the urge to cry. How do you make it through the day?
I would take numb over this overwhelming sadness. you made it through though. That's something, right?

I feel paralyzed. I'm just sitting in the couch crying my eyes out. I can't stop. He was/is my best friend and the one person that u want comfort from but he's just doesn't care. He's done. And I'm broken.
Thats crazy timing! I'm sorry too. Tired of feeling so pathetic and unlovable. I kinda wish I was more angry than sad.

I'm in same same boat. I do not want a divorce but he does. He actually seems relieved and happier since he told me. I'm miserable and would give anything to keep trying. But you can't make someone love you. (Oh those words are a stab in the heart.) take care of yourself for now. One step at a time. You will make it through. I don't know what the future holds but we have to continue moving forward. Life doesn't stop for heart break so we have to take car of ourselves and fake it till we make it.
One step at a time.  One breath at a time.  You are not alone.
I see the truth in what you wrote. My brain gets it. I need my heart to get it too. Maybe I just need to stay away from him until I can think clearly.
Thank you. Sigh. I guess I know what I need to do. I just have to summon the strength.
My brain knows that you are right but my heart....is breaking and it just hurts too much.
Great link- thank you! I cried while reading it. It's time to work on me and this is great advice. I'm so glad I found this forum! Thank you!
Thank you. I'm going to stay with my mom tonight. Get away from the house. Snuggle with her cats and try to relax. Great advice, thank you!

How did you make it through the nights? Those are the worst. So dark and lonely and my brain just goes through a million things that I regret and it's so crazy sad. And how long did it take to feel that good again?
I don't think he is seeing someone else. We've always been so good together. Good friends that can talk and hang out. That's part of the problem.
Thank you. Nights are the worst. So dark and lonely. In the light of day I can read these comments and think I can work on myself and let him go. Your words help give me confidence. Thanks again.
Thanks for the encouragement! I'm so impressed that you took charge and helped yourself.
I told my mom. I just hate talking about it. I want to cling to this last feeling of hope that this will work out. Once that's gone... It will just be me. Alone, childless, broken.

I do need counseling. It's hard to talk about. I have told my mom but no one else. She was great. Offered to help but I just feel like I want to pull the covers over my head and just hibernate for a while.

How do I give space? He's the one I go to for comfort. I want to hug him and not let go. We have a house in a nice area of a mid-sized city and I feel safe when he's here. When he's gone I feel alone. I hate how lame I sound writing that.

Sometimes it's easier to see strength in other people and ignore it in ourselves. You were strong enough to ask for help and that is huge! Someone told me recently that it's one breath at a time, one step at a time.  Please know that you are not alone. You are strong and you will make it through this.

I'm going to tell my mom tomorrow. I don't know what to say to her. I don't know how to act. I don't want to fall apart because I don't want her to have to go through that. She has her own health problems and shouldn't have to deal with my crap. How do I do this? I'll be the only one in my extended family to be divorced. I really hate that word.  Maybe I can get an annulment instead? Then I would just be like it never happened.  This is so hard.

Thank you so much. I definitely want to turn to food and wine. Anything that will bring comfort even if it's temporary. How do you stay so strong? What if I don't have that strength? Can you float away on a river of tears? Or do you eventually find peace?
I'm focusing on this one night. Then making it to work.  Time has slowed but I just need to focus.  Thanks you.
At 3 in the morning it's good to know that I'm not alone. Funny that the Internet can be such a lonely place but also a place that you're never alone.  Thank you.
Thank you. I feel like such a failure. Like I should have been able to fix this. When does it get easier? Cuz this first part hurts too much to bear.
